description: This compound belongs to the class of organic compounds known as perfluoroalkyl phosphonic acid and derivatives. These are organic compounds containing an alkyl chain attached to the phosphorus of a phosphonic acid group (or a derivative thereof), where all hydrogens of the alkyl chain are replaced by fluorine atoms.

direct_parent.description: Organic compounds containing an alkyl chain attached to the phosphorus of a phosphonic acid group (or a derivative thereof), where all hydrogens of the alkyl chain are replaced by fluorine atoms.
direct_parent.name: Perfluoroalkyl phosphonic acid and derivatives

kingdom.name: Organic compounds
